requirements.label: cross-minor
requirements.title: No double use across engineering science minors

rule.text: Courses used to satisfy requirements of another minor in engineering science may not be used to satisfy requirements of another minor in engineering science.
rule.reason: Checking overlap requires the course lists of the other engineering science minors, which are not on this page.

notes.text: Engineering science, computer engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, and applied mathematics and statistics students can assemble a sequence of courses with 18 to 24 credits to satisfy the minor. The student's program must be approved by the undergraduate program director. Advising: Samantha Riccardi, esg_undergradadvising@stonybrook.edu, (631) 632-8381.
